title: PMDS: Phase Modulation Data Service
description:
RDS-style station data for AM radio (station code, name, RadioText, program type and an alert flag), carried as slow phase modulation of a mono AM broadcast carrier: 93.75 bit/s at 8.6 degrees peak deviation, with the envelope, which is what an ordinary AM radio plays, untouched. A draft specification for discussion, not a standard; a reference encoder and decoder in Python; the decoder in C for microcontrollers; and GNU Radio tools for the bench.

Licences: the specification (docs/PMDS_Draft_Specification_version_0.2.md) is under CC BY 4.0; the Python package (pmds/), the C decoder (c/) and the firmware (firmware/) are under the Apache License 2.0; the GNU Radio tools are under the GPL 3.0 or later. Building PMDS equipment needs no permission and no fee.
